name: @ssheleg/telegram-dev
description: Three skills for building on Telegram, separated by which API each one speaks: the official HTTP Bot API for bots, MTProto (Telethon) for user accounts, and Mini Apps for the web layer whose whole security model is one signed blob.

scripts.test: python3 test/validate.py && python3 plugins/telegram-dev/skills/telegram-miniapps/fixtures/verify_initdata.py && python3 plugins/telegram-dev/skills/telegram-bots/fixtures/update_delivery.py --self-test && node test/installer_test.js
